risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantified and detailed, with strong liquidity, cash flow, profitability, and operating metrics supporting a confident tone. Key risks include supply-chain disruption, labor shortages, metal-price and inventory volatility, working-capital demands, and uncertain future COVID-19 impacts. Promotional language and repeated references to the strength of the business model somewhat temper the otherwise transparent presentation.
